description: Source code implementing socket creation, connection, listening, and OVSDB socket management functions for network communication.

methods.name: onewifi_server_socket_create
methods.description: Creates a server socket (TCP or UDP), binds it to the specified address and port.

methods.name: onewifi_client_socket_create
methods.description: Creates a client socket (TCP or UDP).

methods.name: onewifi_client_connect
methods.description: Connects a client socket to a specified server IP and port.

methods.name: onewifi_tcp_server_listen
methods.description: Sets a TCP socket to non-blocking mode, close-on-exec, and starts listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: socket_set_keepalive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive options on a socket.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_conn
methods.description: Establishes a UNIX domain socket connection to an OVSDB server at the specified socket path.
